# EST plugin: an EST sampler in Rust

> An EST plugin is a CLAP 1.2 plugin compiled to WebAssembly (wasm32, no imports), packed with its manifest into a `.est` bundle that a host such as Cyber checks and runs in a sandbox. Start with AGENTS.md. Every file under the first three headings is in this folder (`est new` made it). The pages under "On the web" are not in this folder.

## This plugin

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what to build, the loop, the rules, the library on one page, what costs time
- [est.json](est.json): the manifest
- [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs): the plugin
- [test/golden.json](test/golden.json): the golden render's spec (its events name parameters by id)
- [package.json](package.json): the kit, pinned, and the scripts

## The contract, machine-readable

- [est-manifest-1.schema.json](est-manifest-1.schema.json): the manifest's JSON Schema (est.json's `$schema`)
- [est-validator-rules.json](est-validator-rules.json): every validator rule: `id` (EST-M, -B, -W, -C, -U, -P), `title`, `explain`, `fix`, `severity`
- [est-abi-1.0.json](est-abi-1.0.json): the ABI for EST 1.0: every CLAP struct's layout on wasm32 (only for code written without the kit's runtime)
- [est-abi-1.1.json](est-abi-1.1.json): the same for EST 1.1
- [est-ui.d.ts](est-ui.d.ts): the types of the window's page library (`window.EstUI`)

## The library

- [est/src/lib.rs](est/src/lib.rs): this folder's copy of the kit's Rust crate (the blocks are in `est/src/dsp/`)

## On the web (not in this folder)

- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/dev-host.md : `est dev` and `est dev --json`
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/concepts.md : blocks, events, parameters, state, the sandbox
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/ui.md : a window of your own
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/manifest.md : every est.json field, as a page
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/validator-rules.md : every rule, as a page
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/sdk/docs/PUBLISH_ON_THE_EST_STORE.md : publishing
- https://github.com/NickKHarrison/cyber-est-sdk/blob/main/docs/est/EST_SPECIFICATION_DRAFT.md : the EST specification (background; not needed to write a plugin)
